properties.description: VPN Brute force failures - The rule alerts when failed logins from the same source IP address exceed a certain threshold
properties.query:
let TriggeredIPs =
SecurityAlert
| where DisplayName contains "GO-PRD-SENTINEL-049 VPN Brute force Failures"
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(24h)
| extend A = parse_json(Entities)
| mvexpand A
| extend IP = A.Address
| where isnotempty(IP)
| summarize make_list(IP);
CommonSecurityLog1
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(20m)
| where DeviceVendor =~ "Cisco"
| where Message contains "User authentication failed"
| where DeviceProduct =~ "ASA"
| extend UserName = tostring(extract("Uname:(.*)",1,Message))
| where UserName != " "
| extend SourceIP = extract("(([0-9]{1,3})\\.([0-9]{1,3})\\.([0-9]{1,3})\\.(([0-9]{1,3})))",1,Message)
| where SourceIP !in (TriggeredIPs)
| summarize StartTime = min(TimeGenerated), EndTime = max(TimeGenerated),count(), makeset(UserName) by SourceIP,MF
| where EndTime - StartTime < 10m
| where count_ > 15
| extend IPCustomEntity = SourceIP
| extend URLCustomEntity = tostring(EndTime) // Temporarily added for tracking purpose
